copied_files.note: filenames preserved; body identical to scratch source (md5 verified)

video_integrity_verdict.probe: full sequential decode of all 250 frames per video; mean abs diff vs frame0 (8-bit)

head.verdict: near-static; whole video is essentially one frame with tiny jitter

video_integrity_verdict.cross_episode: for each camera the 4 episode-files are BYTE-IDENTICAL (same md5). ep000==ep001==ep002==ep003. The policy-view videos therefore do NOT encode per-episode trajectory information.
video_integrity_verdict.impact: videos are NOT valid per-episode motion evidence. The JSONL step dump is the authoritative motion evidence and remains fully valid. Terminal frames are meaningless as 'end-of-walk' states because the recordings are near-frozen.

stats.note: episode partition: 4 x 250 dump rows; rows 249/499/749/999 are boundary reset rows (zeroed clipped commands, root teleported to next-episode spawn pose, root_z=0.55 vs walking 0.47). Reset rows are artifacts and are EXCLUDED from all distributions. Stage field is constant value 0 across all 1000 rows.

global.note_12d: action dims 5..10 are identically zero across all 1000 rows (6 unused/grip channels); only dims 0,1,2,3,4,11 carry signal
global.stage_note: stage field constant 0 for all rows; no stage progression recorded in this dump
global.clip_note: dim 1 (vy) and dim 4 most affected by clipping: |unclipped - clipped| mean 0.076 and 0.102

frames.extraction: cv2 sequential-decode; t0 = frame 0, terminal = frame 249 of each video
frames.distinct_content: 18 PNGs collapse to 5 distinct images by md5: head_t0 (x3), head_terminal (x3), left single image (x6), right_t0 (x3), right_terminal (x3)
frames.camera_content_notes_method: multimodal image viewer unavailable in this runtime (look_at agent returned no response, model lacks image input); one-line descriptions below are derived from decoded-pixel statistics of the PNGs (mean brightness, std, dark fraction, edge density, color fraction) plus known camera geometry

camera_descriptions_one_line.head: 384x136 egocentric view, mean brightness 202.5 (std 51.7), 1.2% dark px, edge density 0.026, 0.4% colored px - lit indoor door-task scene with structural content, but effectively ONE frozen frame (max intra-episode drift 0.044/255).
camera_descriptions_one_line.left: 216x384 external side view, mean brightness 234.2 (std 23.5), 0% dark, 0% colored, edge density 0.008 - very bright near-blank low-texture image, FULLY static (all 250 frames bit-identical, same image in every episode).
camera_descriptions_one_line.right: 216x384 external side view, mean brightness 234.8 (std 23.2), 0% dark, 0% colored, edge density 0.012 - very bright near-blank low-texture image, essentially frozen (max drift 0.006/255).

frames.caveat: because recordings are frozen artifacts, t0/terminal extraction yields no genuine motion content; do not cite extracted frames as evidence of walked distance/pose

limitations: Policy-view videos are recording artifacts (near-frozen, per-camera byte-identical across episodes); visual evidence limited to the JSONL.
t0/terminal frame pairing is preserved (frame 0 vs 249) but content is degenerate.
stage field never advances beyond '0' in the dump; stage progression must be sourced elsewhere.
Episode-row alignment between videos and dump is degenerate (videos identical per camera) and cannot be used to disambiguate reset-row placement.
